judged_text: save_host reads params[:embeddable_host][:host] without an envelope check, and the model's before_validation then calls self.host.sub! on the assigned value with no nil check, so a create/update request missing the embeddable_host key (or its host key) crashes with NoMethodError and returns a 500 instead of the render_json_error 4xx the action promises. Any staff API client that POSTs /admin/embeddable_hosts without a proper embeddable_host payload gets a raw 500 rather than the 422 the render_json_error(host) branch exists to return, and a nil host never reaches the model's format validation at all.

adjudication.rationale: In Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host, the code dereferences params[:embeddable_host][:host] and [:category_id] with no guard (app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb). If the request omits the embeddable_host envelope (or its host key), this will raise NoMethodError before reaching the save/validation branch. Additionally, EmbeddableHost’s before_validation unconditionally calls self.host.sub!(...) (app/models/embeddable_host.rb), which will also raise if host is nil. This yields a 500 instead of a structured 4xx/422 error response.
